name: Bosch
title: Disclosure under Reg.30 of SEBI LODR - Earnings call transcript Nov 6, 2026

read.thesis: Bosch Q2 FY27 revenue up 28% with 30% standalone EBITDA growth, but management flagged a more modest H2 and aluminium/forex squeeze with pass-through lagged and not fully recoverable.

triggers.label: H2 outlook turns modest
triggers.quote: We've already stated that the second half is going to be a bit modest.

triggers.label: Full cost recovery not assured
triggers.quote: I cannot, at the moment, predict that we can recuperate 100%.

triggers.label: Two-wheeler Q3 growth flat to modest
triggers.quote: We expect flat to modest growth in Q3 FY27 relative to a high prior-year base.

triggers.label: Bonus issue 3:1 and subdivision
triggers.quote: issue three fully paid bonus equity shares for every one fully paid-up equity share held

guidance.value: flat to modest growth in Q3 FY27
guidance.quote: We expect flat to modest growth in Q3 FY27 relative to a high prior-year base.
We've already stated that the second half is going to be a bit modest.

prior_guidance_check.quote: We expect flat to modest growth in Q3 FY27 relative to a high prior-year base.

red_flags.label: Margin squeeze from aluminium and INR/EUR, pass-through lagged
red_flags.quote: steep increase in raw material prices, mainly aluminum, and adverse forex development due to depreciation of INR versus euro

red_flags.label: Tractor demand weakness, monsoon
red_flags.quote: Tractor demand was the key area of weakness towards the end of Q2.

evasions.quote: I would not want to give you a clear guidance on this
